message.content: I'm not sure exactly when the nodules were first found. I only know they were seen on an exam and that there's a concern about my adrenal glands. I haven't been told about specific symptoms beyond what I've noticed myself: some darker skin over my finger joints and knees. I haven't had fever, night sweats or a cough. I don't have details about fatigue, weight loss or dizziness, and nothing about a recent illness or stressor was mentioned.
